label: FORM_3: FormOf f q identifies f as the putative intelligible FORM_3 of quality q
definition: FormOf f q identifies f as the putative intelligible Form of quality q. It is a relation, not an existence axiom, not a predicate name, and not Aristotelian form in matter. Existence and uniqueness are separate commitments.
note: Semantic interface for the bounded issue #257 readings. Primary passages motivate this sense but do not define this modern relational encoding. A sourced replacement would need a passage fixing precisely these semantic boundaries.
